images.scene: Staff changing room of a small bakery, early morning: a wooden bench in the lower half of the frame with a neatly folded white baker's apron and a cloth cap on it, and on top of the apron a sealed brown paper pay envelope, untouched. Behind, an open metal locker, completely empty, its door ajar. No people. Hard light from a small high window. The wall above dissolves into bright haze.

Close on a bakery counter: the owner's hand passes a thick brown paper pay envelope across the flour-dusted wooden counter into the open hand of a worker; only the two hands, forearms and the envelope fill the lower half of the frame, huge and close. Rolled sleeves, flour on the skin. Pale haze above.

CLOSE on a young baker in a white apron and cap, seen from the chest up, leaning on the frame of the open back door of a small bakery at dawn, floured hands, his face turned up toward the rising light with a quiet hopeful expression; he is LARGE in the frame, filling the lower three quarters, head whole with air above it, ONE strong warm side light from the sunrise on his face. Only the door frame and a sliver of the dark bakery behind him; the wall above his head is bright overexposed morning haze with nothing crossing it. Camera at chest height.

An old mechanical wall time-clock with a rack of cardboard punch cards beside it, in the dim back corridor of a bakery before dawn; a tired worker's hand, seen from the side and very close, slides a card into the slot. Only the arm, the hand, the card and the machine are in frame, large in the lower half. The punch cards are blank and any marks on them are faint and illegible. Pale wall above dissolving into haze.

Inside a small bakery at first light, CLOSE: three bakers shoulder to shoulder pull a tray of fresh bread out of a big brick oven together, steam rising, all three leaning in and laughing, faces lit by the oven glow; one holds the wooden peel. Seen from the waist up, the three men fill the frame edge to edge. CINEMA CLAUSE: camera at chest height, ONE strong side light source, every head is WHOLE with air above it, never cut at the neck, shoulders or waist. THE PEOPLE ARE LARGE AND CLOSE, seen from the chest or waist up, filling the bottom three quarters of the frame; their heads reach up to about one fifth from the top, with only bright haze above them.

Night inside a small bakery: a worker with sleeves rolled up kneels on the floor with his arm deep inside the open belly of a big industrial dough mixer that broke down, a small flashlight held in his mouth, wrenches and bolts on the floor beside his knee, flour everywhere. Seen from close and low; the machine and the man fill the lower three quarters. The dim space above dissolves into pale haze.

The doorway light and the wall above dissolve into bright overexposed haze.
